summary.headline: Tetrabiblos Meteorological Apparatus
summary.text: Astrological delineation of Mars by terms, trigon, participation, exaltation, depression, decan, face, and monomoiria, followed by a critical apparatus for book II, chapter 3 of Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos on meteors involving the Sun, Moon, stars, winds, clouds, and weather omens. The apparatus compares manuscripts V and M with the 1553 edition and records variant readings through pages 100–103.
